38.
(1) A person shall not distribute, sell or offer for sale,
any  article  which  is  not  a  tobacco  product  or  an  alcohol
product,  bearing  the  trade  mark,  characteristic  symbols,
distinctive  logo, or brand name of a tobacco product or any
alcohol  product.
(2) A person shall not manufacture or import for sale, or
distribute free of charge, any article which is not a tobacco
product having the appearance of a tobacco product.
(3)  Any  manufacturer  or  importer  who  contravenes  the
provisions of subsection (1) or any person who contravenes
the  provisions  of  subsection  (2)  or  subsection  (3)  shall  be
guilty  of  an  offence  under  this  Act  and    shall  be  liable  on
conviction after summary trial before a Magistrate to a fine
not exceeding fifty thousand rupees or to imprisonment for a
period  not  exceeding  two  years  or  to  both  such  fine  and
imprisonment.
